description: One parcel's stored record and its checks: the county value, last sale, years held, lot, zoning line, water, outbuildings, the recorded signs an owner may sell, and (Colorado) every stored check such as tax delinquency, estate records, code cases, permits, wildfire and flood. Find it by shinnslist key, by street address (with ZIP when you have it), or by latitude and longitude.

address.description: A street address, like 874 Cold Spring Rd.

key.description: The shinnslist parcel key, like CO|Boulder|R0012345, from an earlier answer.

lat.description: Latitude in decimal degrees, with lng.

lng.description: Longitude in decimal degrees, with lat.
